question: Which of the following is the official language of Afghanistan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dari**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dari** is one of the official languages of Afghanistan, alongside Pashto.
 
• Dari, also known as Afghan Persian, is widely used for administration and in the media.
 
• It serves as the lingua franca in Afghanistan, facilitating communication among different ethnic groups.
 
• As a variety of Persian, Dari shares linguistic similar
